newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds up to new record on Capel upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds up to new record on Capel upgrade.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Group rose to a fresh record in early trading on Wednesday after HSBC James Capel issued a buy note on the stock, targeting the share price at 775p, dealers said.
At 0847 GMT, the shares were up 5p to 651p, having climbed as high as 662 initially. They were among the most actively traded in London, with more than five million shares registered.
The rest of the bank sector, which has led the FTSE 100 to new record levels, was generally mixed.
The brokerage lifted its annual earnings estimate for Lloyds by 200 million stg to 3.250 billion stg, citing improved margins and better cost cutting, dealers said.
